payload.summary: The account 'jdoe' experienced a brute force attack from the IP address 198.51.100.77, which had no prior successful logins in the 30 days before the incident. The successful login occurred after 13 consecutive failures, indicating a potential compromise.

attack_chain.description: An attacker used brute force techniques to guess the password of the account 'jdoe' from the IP address 198.51.100.77.

risk_factors: Brute force attack indicates potential unauthorized access
IP address with no prior successful logins

proposed_actions.justification: The account 'jdoe' was the target of a brute force attack, indicating a potential compromise.
